description:
READ THIS FIRST: THIS PACK IS ABOUT BEING HIT BY THE BALL, NOT ABOUT TACKLES. It is a secondary, readability-only pack. It does NOT serve 'fall over more with contact and tackles' directly and it will not produce one extra fall. It is included because it is a cheap, low-risk way to stop one specific class of contact looking weightless. If you only have one evening, test falls-slide-tackle-contact.json instead.

WHAT CHANGES. match::anime::action::Stagger::vf30 (0x143effd70) picks WHICH stagger animation plays once the engine has already decided a stagger happens. Part of that choice is a severity boolean: it takes the horizontal speed of an object, converts it to km/h and asks whether it exceeds 75. If yes, the heavy stagger motions (0x226 / 0x227) are eligible instead of the normal one (0x221). This pack lowers that line from 75 km/h to 60 km/h by re-aiming the comparison's disp32 to a different existing pool cell. Nothing is written to any shared cell.

STRONGER VERSION: 45.0 instead of 60.0 - re-aim 0x143effe99 to cell 0x145b1d910, patch bytes 0F2F0570DAC101. Do not go below 45 without an A/B; at some point every deflection off a shin plays the heavy animation.

WHO IT AFFECTS: EVERYONE - your stick-controlled player, your AI team-mates and the CPU.

WHAT IS DEMONSTRATED (b-DISASSEMBLY, not emulated). The arithmetic chain was read instruction by instruction from the installed image this pass and is unambiguous: 0x143effe6f calls the vec3 getter 0x1443070d0; 0x143effe74 and 0x143effe78 take components [0] and [8], i.e. the two horizontal axes; 0x143effe7d-0x143effe89 square, sum and square-root them; 0x143effe8e multiplies by pool cell 0x146a820f0 = 3.5999999 (the metres-per-second to km/h constant used throughout the ball code); 0x143effe99 compares against 0x145e9c05c = 75.0; 0x143effea0 stores the result with 'seta byte ptr [rbp+0x7f]'. That byte has exactly two references in the function - written here, read at 0x143efff9a - and feeds r15b, which at 0x143f0008a and 0x143f000d1 selects motion 0x226/0x227 over 0x221. So the units are km/h and the boolean is a severity flag.

WHAT IS NOT PROVEN (c-INFERRED) - AND THIS PASS MADE IT LESS CERTAIN, NOT MORE. That the object being measured is THE BALL. The accessor 0x1442d6c50 was disassembled this pass and it is NOT a plain 'get the ball' field load: it reads a match-world singleton at 0x1486bd888, offsets by 0x58, and tail-calls a small indexed container helper (0x1443070f0) that reads an index from the container header, returns NULL if that index is >= 3, and otherwise loads a pointer at stride 0x58. It has ~1524 call sites, so it is the most-referenced match object in the game, which is consistent with the ball but does not prove it. THE STRONGEST ARGUMENT that it is the ball, and it is still only an argument: 75 km/h is unreachable for a human player (top sprint is around 36 km/h), so if the subject were a player this branch would be permanently dead code, seta and all. NOTE THE BOUNDED DOWNSIDE THIS GIVES YOU: 60 km/h and even 45 km/h are also above any player's top speed, so if the inference is wrong the worst case is that this pack does NOTHING AT ALL. It cannot misfire on player-speed contact.

EXPECTED EFFECT ON FOULS AND CARDS: NONE. This is animation selection inside an action that has already started. No score term, no whistle threshold, no card line is touched.

WHAT TO LOOK FOR IN ONE MATCH. A player struck by a hard pass, a blocked shot or a clearance at close range should now visibly buckle rather than absorb it flat. Blocks in the box and deflections off defenders are where you will see it. Frequency of staggers should be completely unchanged - if you think you are seeing MORE staggers, that is not this pack.

WHAT WOULD MEAN IT IS TOO STRONG. Heavy stagger animations firing on ordinary passes, or players buckling from balls that visibly were not hit hard - it will look melodramatic and slapstick. If the match feels unchanged, that is the expected outcome for the c-inferred risk above; revert and lose nothing.

COLLISIONS: none. 0x143effe99 is byte-identical between the INSTALLED image and eFootball.exe.PRISTINE (both 0F2F05BCC1F901, verified this pass). Not in the applied kick-error bytes and not overlapping any unapplied spec.

REVERT: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/falls-ballhit-severity.json

patches.name: heavy stagger severity line 75 km/h -> 60 km/h (disp32 re-aim)
patches.note: comiss xmm0,[rip+0x1f9c1bc -> 0x145e9c05c = 75.0] re-aimed to [rip+0x1b8dee4 -> 0x145a8dd84 = 60.0]. disp32 recomputed by hand as 0x145a8dd84 - 0x143effea0 = 0x1b8dee4. xmm0 at this point is sqrt(v[0]^2 + v[2]^2) * 3.6, i.e. km/h. No pool cell is written.
